faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Assistant Cook post at OAV Sarifpur?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Assistant Cook position at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Sarifpur is 09 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the salary offered for the Assistant Cook role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Cook post will receive a monthly salary of Rs. 6750. This is a contractual position with a fixed monthly remuneration.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Assistant Cook recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit for applying to the Assistant Cook post is between 21 years and 32 years. Candidates must fall within this age bracket to be eligible for the recruitment.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the OAV Sarifpur Assistant Cook recruitment is offline. Candidates need to download the application form, fill it correctly, attach necessary documents, and send it to the official address before the last date.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for the Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for the Assistant Cook post at OAV Sarifpur. Both General/OBC and SC/ST category candidates are exempted from paying any application fee.

faq.question: Q6. What are the selection criteria for the Assistant Cook position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Cook post includes a physical cooking test and an evaluation by a committee. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in these stages.

faq.question: Q7. What is the total number of vacancies for the Assistant Cook post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Assistant Cook post at Odisha Adarsha Vidyalaya Sarifpur. This is a single opening advertised in the recent notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the preferred qualification for the Assistant Cook role?
faq.answer: While not strictly mandatory, preference will be given to candidates who are trained in cookery. This indicates that prior training or experience in cooking will be an advantage.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Assistant Cook position at OAV Sarifpur is a contractual job. This means the appointment will be for a fixed period as per the terms and conditions of the contract.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the organization, which is puri.odisha.gov.in. It is advisable to check the website for the most up-to-date information and forms.
